name: Auto Retina
description: Automatically generates high-magnification (retina) derivatives for any image style by appending a suffix (e.g. @2x) to the filename.

suggests.drupal/image_style_quality: Adds finer control over the JPEG quality of retina output.
suggests.drupal/imageapi_optimize: When present, retina styles run through an Image Optimize pipeline.

project_description: Auto Retina extends core image styles by delivering a high-magnification (retina) derivative of any defined image style on demand. A visitor requests the retina version simply by appending a configured suffix (default @2x) before the file extension of an existing image-style derivative URL, e.g. my-photo@2x.jpg. The module intercepts core's image-style delivery routes (image.style_public and image.style_private) with its own RetinaImageStyleDownloadController, resolves the base image, applies the style effects scaled by the magnification multiplier, and generates the enlarged derivative (upscaling capped when the source image is too small to reach optimum quality). Multiple multipliers can be configured (e.g. @.75x @1.5x @2x @3x), a JPEG quality multiplier trims file size on magnified images, and a low-quality event/log entry flags source images that are too small. It does not detect retina devices or emit HTML/srcset markup; it only produces the derivative files, leaving front-end selection to the theme or other modules.
